## Summary Report: Polyglot Node Backend Mutation Endpoints & Registry

### 1. PATCH/PUT/POST Endpoints Mutating Agent/Registry

**Registry Mutations (orgHr.js):**
- `PATCH /api/org/agent/:id` — Updates registry record via `org.upsertAgent()`
- `POST /api/hr/promote/:agent` — Promotes agent, calls `hr.promoteAgent()`
- `POST /api/hr/pip/:agent` — Opens PIP status, calls `hr.openPip()`
- `POST /api/hr/pip/:agent/close` — Closes PIP, calls `hr.closePip()`
- `POST /api/hr/retire/:agent` — Retires agent, calls `hr.retireAgent()`
- `POST /api/hr/unretire/:agent` — Reactivates agent, calls `hr.unretireAgent()`
- `POST /api/hr/hire` — Onboards new agent, calls `hr.hireAgent()`
- `POST /api/experience/recompute` — Recalculates XP/levels via `experience.recomputeAllExperience()`

**Agent File Mutations (agents.js):**
- `PUT /api/global/agents/:name` — Replaces agent markdown; snapshots prior version
- `DELETE /api/global/agents/:name` — Removes agent file
- `POST /api/global/agents/:name/rollback/:ts` — Restores from timestamped snapshot
- `PUT /api/projects/:id/agents/:name` — Project-scoped agent file replace
- `DELETE /api/projects/:id/agents/:name` — Project-scoped agent file removal

### 2. Registry Agent Editable Fields

The `PATCH /api/org/agent/:id` allowed fields array (line 105, orgHr.js):
- **department**, **subDepartment**, **pod**, **phase**, **reportsTo**, **secondaryReportsTo**
- **title**, **tier**, **status**, **tags**, **squad**

Total: **11 fields**. The full agents table (db.js:266-298) also stores level, levelTitle, yearsOfExperience, experiencePoints, hiredAt, retiredAt, retiredReason, pip, etc., but these are NOT directly PATCH-editable—only settable via HR operations (promote, hire, retire, pip).

### 3. History/Audit Support

**Two separate audit systems:**
1. **Agent File Snapshots** — `agents.js:snapshotAgent()` creates timestamped .md copies in `/agent-versions/{agentName}/` (max 20 kept). Accessible via `GET /api/global/agents/:name/versions` and `GET /api/global/agents/:name/versions/:ts`.
2. **Memory Audit Log** (SQLite) — Tracks CLAUDE.md / memory edits: 13 columns including `action` (create/update/delete/merge), `path`, `linesAdded/Removed`, `diff`, `contentSnapshot`, `fromPath`, `toPath`, `timestamp`. No registry-specific history table; registry mutations write only current state.

**No agent registry undo/rollback** — registry changes (promote, hire, retire) are transactional but not versioned.

### 4. Real-Time SSE Sync

**YES—full broadcast on registry edits:**
- `GET /api/org-chart/stream` opens SSE connection
- `agentSync.js` exports EventEmitter listening on file changes
- **File upserts** (`upsertFromDisk()`) emit `agent:upsert` with agent record (line 82)
- **File removals** (`markRemoved()`) emit `agent:remove` (line 100)
- orgHr.js `PATCH /api/org/agent/:id` calls `org.upsertAgent()`, which calls `db.saveRegistry()` → SQLite write only
- **GAP:** Registry mutations (promote, hire, retire, PIP) bypass agentSync and do NOT emit SSE events. Only file-system-triggered upserts broadcast.
